faqs.answer: Yes, for fresh-cut fries. Thirty minutes in cold water pulls out the surface starch, and dry fries crisp where wet fries steam. Pat them dry before the oil goes on.
faqs.question: Do I need to soak fries before air frying?

faqs.answer: A teaspoon or two tossed through a pound of fries. Frozen fries need none, because they already hold oil from the factory.
faqs.question: How much oil do fries need in the air fryer?

faqs.answer: Usually the basket was too full. Fries need a single layer with air between them. Cook in two batches, and shake halfway through each one.
faqs.question: Why are my air fryer fries soggy?

faqs.answer: The conversion is the same, but frozen fries skip the soak and need no oil. Fresh fries need the soak, the drying, and the teaspoon of oil.
faqs.question: Can I cook frozen fries and fresh fries the same way?

faqs.answer: 400F in the air fryer for most oven recipes, which bake at 425F. Thin shoestring fries do better a little lower, at 375F, so they crisp before they burn.
faqs.question: What temperature is best for fries?

felicityNote: The soak is the boring step and the one that decides everything. Thirty minutes in cold water, then dry them like you mean it.

parts.meaning: The air fryer runs hotter than the dial says, because the fan pushes hot air straight onto the food. Dropping 25F keeps the outside from burning before the centre cooks.
The fan cooks food about 20 percent faster than still oven air, so the air fryer time is four fifths of the oven time.
The check-at time is 70 percent of the oven time. Open the basket then and look for golden edges.
Fries in one layer crisp on every side. A piled basket steams in the middle, and no conversion fixes that.

formula.text: Air fryer temp = oven temp minus 25F. Air fryer time = oven time × 0.8. Check at = oven time × 0.7. For french fries at 425F for 30 minutes: 400F for 24 minutes, check at 21 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Read the oven settings
howToSteps.text: Find the temperature and time in your recipe. Fresh fries usually bake at 425F for 30 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Convert both numbers
howToSteps.text: Take 25F off the temperature and take 20 percent off the time. 425F for 30 minutes becomes 400F for 24 minutes.

howToSteps.name: Soak, dry, and oil
howToSteps.text: Soak the cut fries for 30 minutes, pat them dry, and toss with a teaspoon or two of oil.

howToSteps.name: Cook and shake
howToSteps.text: Spread in a single layer and shake halfway. Start checking at 21 minutes, and pull them when the edges are golden.

lede: Fresh fries that bake at 425F for 30 minutes air fry at 400F for 24 minutes. Shake the basket halfway and start checking at 21 minutes, when the edges turn golden.

title: Oven to Air Fryer: French Fries
tutorial: Fresh fries are where the air fryer earns its counter space. A tray of hand-cut fries that bakes at 425F for 30 minutes air fries at 400F for 24 minutes, and they come out crisper because the hot air reaches every side. Start checking at 21 minutes.

The soak matters more than the temperature. Cut the potatoes, soak them in cold water for at least 30 minutes, and pat them dry. The soak pulls out surface starch, and starch is what makes fries stick together and go limp. Skip the soak and the conversion will not save them.

Cut them the same size. Fries cook by thickness, and a thick fry next to a thin one means one is raw while the other burns. Aim for a quarter inch thick, and cut the long ones in half so they fit in one layer. A mandoline makes this fast, and a sharp knife and a steady hand do the same job.

Oil is a teaspoon, not a pour. Toss the dry fries in a bowl with a teaspoon or two of oil before they go in. The oil carries the heat into the surface and helps it brown. No oil at all gives pale, leathery fries. Too much oil smokes.

Two batches beat one crowded basket. Fries piled two deep steam in the middle, and shaking cannot fix a basket that is too full. Cook half, keep them warm under foil, and cook the second half. The second batch cooks faster, because the fryer is fully hot by then.
